fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kog'Maw''' spits a globule of acid into the air that drops to the target location after {{fd|0.6}} seconds, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area before dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds. ''Living Artillery's'' damage is increased by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 50 for 11|key1=%|0 to 60|formula=0.833% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 50% increase at 60% '''missing''' health.''}}|health}}, or instead by {{ccs|100%|magic}} if the target is below {{as|40% '''maximum''' health}}.
fields.leveling: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 180}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35 to 45}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|100*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*2 to 45*2}}% AP)}}}}
fields.description2: '''Kog'Maw''' then generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Living Artillery'' for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times.
fields.description3: {{sbc|Living Artillery:}} For each stack, ''Living Artillery's'' {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is increased by {{as|40|mana}}.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
